resources.string: Attendance is marked by teachers and usually appears the same day after 2 PM. If a day looks missing, pull down to refresh the Attendance screen — if it\'s still blank, contact the class teacher.
Open the Fees tab from the bottom bar, tap any pending fee head and select Pay to launch Razorpay secure checkout. Receipts appear under Paid Fees the moment payment succeeds.
Tap the Academics tab in the bottom bar — Homework, Results, Timetable and Exam schedule all live there.
Scroll up on this Profile tab, open \"Change password\", enter your current password and a new one of 6+ characters, then tap Update.
Make sure Notifications are enabled in Settings → Notifications. Notices from your school also appear in the Notices tab even if the push was missed.
